section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the data analysis methodology used in the study. It details the use of HotDeck Imputation for handling missing data (2.2%), computation of descriptive statistics and correlations using SPSS version 18, and structural equation modeling using Mplus version 7 with WLSMV estimation. The section specifies fit indices and criteria (TLI, CFI, RMSEA, WRMR) used to assess model fit, and mentions the use of Sobel's test to evaluate indirect effects.
